London AdvancedAbout this tool
Start with how you want London to feel

A different way to decide where to go.

Most London lists begin with a category: museum, park, viewpoint or market. London by Mood begins with the experience you want—quiet, beautiful, green, unexpected, atmospheric, local, a little weird or simply somewhere to wander.

The tool ranks more than 800 places using London Advanced’s editorial assessments, your chosen mood and the practical limits of your journey.

Useful for
  • Unplanned afternoons
  • Repeat visits to London
  • Choosing between many options
  • Matching a place to your energy
How to use it

Turn a feeling into a shortlist.

  1. 01

    Choose a mood

    Select quiet, unexpected, beautiful, a little weird, local, green, atmospheric or somewhere to wander.

  2. 02

    Choose travel mode

    Select walking or public transport so the journey-time limit is interpreted appropriately.

  3. 03

    Set your starting point

    Enter a London address or postcode, or use one of the available starting locations.

  4. 04

    Review suggestions

    Compare mood fit, location, estimated journey time and the editorial reason each place was selected.

How it is built

Editorial fit plus practical limits.

Each place in the London Advanced collection has been reviewed against several moods and practical characteristics. Ranking combines those editorial scores with your location, travel mode and maximum journey time.

Address lookup uses OpenStreetMap’s Nominatim service. Directions open in Google Maps after you choose a result.

What to know

A recommendation, not a guarantee.

Journey times are conservative ranking estimates, not live TfL results. They may not reflect disruption, waiting time, walking pace or temporary route changes.

Search is limited to London. Opening hours, booking requirements and access conditions should be checked with the official source.
